text:
Priya Nair: quick ping 1: nightly crawler found 5 internal 404s on onboarding/setup.html in staging + one iframe that 403s from ghusercontent. Not blocking but new hires hit this page.
Tom B: can you paste the exact paths? I can triage after standup.
link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-22T06:45Z 1: 5 dead internal links detected in onboarding/setup.html. examples: /assets/images/setup-arch.png, /examples/server-stream, /examples/kv-cache, /api/v1/old-auth, /runbook/faststart. iframe resource 403: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redwood/examples/main/embed/setup-iframe.html. full report: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/1740000001
Priya Nair: thanks. I think the image was moved to /assets/images/arch/setup-arch.png during the asset reorg. The examples got namespaced under /examples/v2/. I can open a tiny PR to patch the html and swap the iframe to the rehosted gist link.
Alex Gomez: FYI the /api/v1/old-auth -> /api/auth/login change might affect support snippets. If you change it, add a changelog line so SRE/support are aware.
Tom B: agree. Also if the iframe is 3rd-party-hosted we should rehost under our CDN. Docs team prefers embedding from /static/embed/ so we can control uptime.
Priya Nair: plan: run a targeted sed replace locally, update the iframe src to /static/embed/setup-iframe.html (I will rehost the file in the CDN bucket in the same PR), and add a 1-liner in the PR body about the auth endpoint rename. quick sed I used: 
```bash
rg "/assets/images/setup-arch.png|/examples/server-stream|/api/v1/old-auth" -n docs/ && \
sed -i 's@/assets/images/setup-arch.png@/assets/images/arch/setup-arch.png@g' docs/onboarding/setup.html && \
sed -i 's@/examples/server-stream@/examples/v2/server-stream@g' docs/onboarding/setup.html && \
sed -i 's@/api/v1/old-auth@/api/auth/login@g' docs/onboarding/setup.html
```
Alex Gomez: small nit: for image paths prefer relative links in the repo so preview works locally (e.g., `./assets/images/arch/setup-arch.png`). Otherwise LGTM.
Priya Nair: good call. I'll switch the image to relative and push. Also I'll attach the CDN upload hash in the PR body.
docs-oncall: if PR is low-risk and CI passes we can merge to get staging fixed before the next nightly. Please tag me.
Priya Nair: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/7999 1: includes image path fix, example path rename, iframe rehost under /static/embed/, plus changelog note. Tagging @Tom B and @Alex for review.
Tom B: doing a quick review now. tiny suggestion: add a line in the changelog about the iframe now being served from CDN (helps debug cache issues).
Alex Gomez: reviewed, added one style nit about alt text on the image (missing alt).
Priya Nair: fixed both nit + updated changelog. CI green. Merging in 2m.
link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled post-merge to validate.
Priya Nair: thanks all 1: will monitor the re-scan and ping if anything else pops up.
